chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:

By the One in Whose hand is the soul of Abū al-Qāsim, no one declares Allah's oneness and no one magnifies Allah upon any elevated place except that what is behind him declares Allah's oneness and what is before him magnifies Him with his tahlīl and takbīr, until it reaches the limit of the soil.

key_terms.كَبَّرَ: magnified Allah by saying Allāhu Akbar
key_terms.مَقْطَعَ التُّرَابِ: the farthest limit or end of the earth/soil
key_terms.هَلَّلَ: declared Allah's oneness by saying lā ilāha illā Allāh

ai.seo_question: What happens when a person says tahlil and takbir while traveling on a high place?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the immense effect of dhikr uttered from an elevated place, especially tahlīl and takbīr. It portrays creation as responding to the remembrance of Allah, emphasizing the spiritual reach and significance of glorifying Him.
